text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur and I are finishing up a
short-term
high-altitude training trip. I
planned for us to
take a bus back to
campus, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey. Will you quit moping already?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An unexpected downpour led to
constant delays
and, ultimately, we
missed the last bus.
choice_data_list: Still, to think it would pour like that...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Even with radar equipment, it's
particularly
difficult to get precise
weather measurements for
mountainous
areas.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It takes quite an ego to think you can
plan things
perfectly in the face of that.
Let's just deal with
the practical matters
at hand, and figure out how
we're going
to get back.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
We can't get a phone signal here. And
the map
doesn't show any houses or
parking areas nearby.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But the GPS can still show us our current
location.
I figure all we can do is walk
down the mountain
until we get a signal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds easy enough, but she's been
undergoing
intense high-altitude
training. It'll take her some
time to
recover, and I don't want to put any
more
burden on her if I can help it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Whew.
Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look around and spot an open area in
the
distance that I checked out when we
first arrived
in the mountains.
choice_data_list: (If only I could get a signal...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey. What're you doing wandering all
over the
place staring at your phone?
You're distracting
me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
We're not here for sightseeing. Plus, I
doubt your
body is used to the altitude
yet.
choice_data_list: I just wanted to look at the view.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I didn't tell her at the time, but I was
searching for
spots around the training
area where I could get a
phone signal,
just in case something like this

happened.
choice_data_list: Of course, I won't push myself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At that time, my phone was able to
connect a few
times around the ridgeline
and in some open
areas. The place I just
spotted is near one of
those spots.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Considering the radio waves are
travelling
downwards, there's a slight
chance we might be
able to catch a
signal! But we'd have to leave the
road,
which presents its own risks...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Hey!
choice_data_list: Wait right here, okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I managed to get a signal at the spot I
had my
eye on, and people at the base
of the mountain
sent a car up for us.
choice_data_list: I'm so glad we were able to call a car.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Was it really worth it? There was no
need for you
to injure yourself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I was so absorbed in making my way
through the
dark mountain path that I
must have scraped
myself on a branch or
something without realizing
it.
choice_data_list: It's just a scratch.
It's just a scratch, really.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What you should've done is tell me you
were
looking for a place with a signal.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I could've analyzed the distance to the
base
station and the topography to
narrow down likely
spots. Though it still
would've been so inefficient
and hardly
worth the time...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It would've been way faster to just walk.
So...
that's what we should've done.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Don't go wasting your energy like that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Pure coincidence.
choice_data_list: Every once in a blue moon it doesn't go to waste, like today.
Every once in a while it doesn't go to waste, like today.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Like I said earlier, you should've told me
what you
were trying to do. I would've
gone instead, and it
would've been much
faster.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Maybe that's why they didn't say anything.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...
No one asked you to do that.
choice_data_list: Because I wanted to protect you.
Because I wanted to protect you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Tch. And yet look who passed out first.
choice_data_list: Get some good rest until we arrive.
Get some good rest until we arrive.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Waste of energy," huh? I'm sure one to
talk.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Look at those damn stars, twinkling up
there.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(There was a time when people believed
the
unscientific claim that the sky
revolved around us.
But back then, the
idea that the Earth was what
moved
seemed crazy.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(All that energy spent arguing was
wasted. Of
course, we all know that
now.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: But I don't have time to wait for "someday" or "coincidences" to roll around for everyone to understand. I have to prove things now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's just before midnight. I guess I can
still do
everything I had planned
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's just before midnight. I guess I can
still do
everything I had planned
tomorrow.
choice_data_list: Make sure to get plenty of rest.
Make sure to get plenty of rest, okay?
Next time, I'll anticipate every possible scenario.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I'd have to be some kind of
idiot to go
running.
choice_data_list: Make sure to get plenty of rest.
Make sure to get plenty of rest, okay?
Next time, I'll anticipate every possible scenario.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: Because I want your brain to get plenty of rest too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. I'll be dedicating all my
resources to
resting.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Seeing as you worked so hard to protect
me and
all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You do that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...And I will too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But not today. All you need to do today
is grab a
quick bath and hit the sack.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm serious. Don't even think about it.

...Later.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...
Thanks.
choice_data_list: Good night.
